summary.ko: 키보드·이름·구조·대비 등 검증 가능한 접근성 문제와 개선안을 정리합니다.
summary.en: Identify evidence-backed accessibility problems and focused remediation steps.

exclusions: General visual polish without an accessibility goal

required_inputs.description: Relevant markup, interface, or screenshots and user flows
Target pages, devices, and available inspection methods

workflow.instruction: Inventory semantic structure, accessible names, focus order, keyboard interaction, labels, errors, and motion behavior.
Check concrete elements against the applicable accessibility criteria and record evidence, affected users, and reproduction steps.
Prioritize blockers in core tasks; propose minimal markup, interaction, or content fixes with verification instructions.
Retest available fixes and separate automated findings, manual checks, and checks that still require assistive technology.

deliverables.name: Accessibility findings
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Each finding has evidence, impact, affected location, and a reproducible check

deliverables.name: Remediation checklist
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Contains prioritized fixes and verification status

limitations: Do not certify legal compliance or full conformance from a partial inspection.
Screenshots cannot establish keyboard or screen-reader behavior.
permission_boundaries: Only inspect or edit the authorized target; do not change product-wide settings without approval.
Do not send user interaction recordings to third parties.
